hypothesis_title: Track B — Skewness Forensics × CFO Accrual Nonlinear Cross-family Diversifier
hypothesis_description:
Iter 16 — 새 alpha source 탐색. Cross-family low-corr diversifier. Iter 9 nonlinear refinement.

## 동기 (진정한 분산, Track B)
- STR_1701 (PG2 active 80%) cor < 0.30 진정한 diversifier
- Iter 9 (Growth × Investor_Flow) linear composite fail 학습 (L-211)
- Iter 13 ML 실패 학습 — KR top universe 단순 ML 회피
- Sharpe upside +0.20~0.40 (분산 효과로 SR 2.0 도달 가능)

## 핵심 가설 (Iter 9 nonlinear refinement)
- Skewness Forensics (Chen-Hong-Stein 2001 NCSKEW + Hong-Stein 1999 disagreement)
- × CFO accrual quality (Sloan 1996, Dechow-Sloan-Sweeney 1995)
- **Nonlinear sigmoid interaction** (Iter 9 linear composite cancellation 회피)
- 가설: skewness-extreme + accrual-quality 동시 충족 시 alpha (sigmoid intersection)

## Factor design
1. **NCSKEW** (Chen-Hong-Stein 2001):
   - NCSKEW_t = -[n(n-1)^1.5 × Σr³] / [(n-1)(n-2) × (Σr²)^1.5]
   - 60-day rolling, t-1 lag
   - Higher NCSKEW = more crash risk
2. **CFO Accrual Quality** (Sloan 1996):
   - Accrual = (NI - CFO) / Total Assets
   - DART data PIT (annual May 5월 lag, quarterly 45-day)
   - Lower accrual = higher quality (less earnings management)
3. **Nonlinear Sigmoid Interaction**:
   - alpha = sigmoid(-NCSKEW_z × 2) × sigmoid(-Accrual_z × 2)
   - both extreme low → high alpha (joint condition)
   - 단순 평균 -0.014 vs -0.015 (Iter 9 cancellation 패턴) 회피

## L-211 회피 mandate (KR linear composite fail)
- Linear composite 금지
- Sigmoid joint conditioning
- Regime-conditional 가능 (BULL only sub-strategy 검토)
- Single-axis 회피 (multi-feature joint)

## 핵심 mandate (Track B 진정한 diversifier)

- TDC q5 vs PG2 (STR_1701) < 0.30

- 평가: PG2 trio (STR_1701 60% + V3 20% + STR_1656 20%) realized SR > 1.4625
  또는 alternative blend (V3 부분 추가 + STR_1656 보존 또는 교체)
